ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to FSHN undergraduate and graduate students only until after junior registration. Remaining seats will be released to the general student population when sophomore registration opens. If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Admissions then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in January. Until that time, it is up to you to continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior, Junior, or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BS:Fd Sci & Hmn Nutrn-FS -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, PHD:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or MS: Food Sc Hum N - PSM -UIUC.
